purpose: Replace the mathematically unreachable v1 multi-ring vertex-gradient contract with a two-ring endpoint plus renderer interpolation contract while preserving the v1 luminance, material, geometry, ownership, evidence and authorization gates.

v1_supersession.supersession_reason: The frozen sidewall topology has only upper and lower vertex rings. With upper scalar >=0.95 and lower scalar <=0.42, every cross-ring indexed edge has scalar difference >=0.53. The v1 maximum adjacent vertex step <=0.15, cubic transition and explicit intermediate plateaus therefore require unavailable intermediate rings while v1 simultaneously freezes POSITION and indices.
not_relaxed: strict rim > sidewall_upper > sidewall_lower > void chain
sidewall material and endpoint color ranges
geometry, indices, ownership, camera, lighting and tone-map freezes

independently_verified_v10f_sidewall_top.verification_method: Decode the embedded glTF buffer; read each sidewall primitive POSITION and index accessor; count distinct Y values and unique undirected indexed edges whose endpoint Y values differ.

allowed_change_scope: sidewall-only roughness within the declared range
sidewall COLOR_0 neutral values on the two existing endpoint rings
new v10g metadata and offline calibration or validation code
forbidden_change_scope: adding an intermediate sidewall ring or vertex
changing sidewall POSITION, NORMAL, TANGENT, TEXCOORD_0, indices, primitive topology, node transform or ownership
rim or void geometry, material or COLOR_0
felt, walnut, cushion or facing geometry or materials
camera, lighting rig, exposure, tone-map operator, MSAA, quality or viewport
shader source, shader branch, interpolation qualifier or runtime toggle
texture, emissive term, light or render pass

two_ring_endpoint_contract.coordinate: geometry-local Y; the ring at Y=0.85883975 is upper and the ring at Y=0.83597976 is lower
two_ring_endpoint_contract.interpolation_owner: existing GPU vertex-to-fragment smooth perspective-correct barycentric interpolation
two_ring_endpoint_contract.reason: Continuity is supplied inside existing indexed triangles by the frozen renderer; vertex adjacency cannot be used as a smoothness proxy on a two-ring mesh.

offline_search_policy.candidate_selection: Select the lowest-energy candidate satisfying D_cpu>=47.6, calibrated D_gpu_lower>=16 and every inherited and v2 continuity gate.

machine_testable_interpolation_quality_c.domain: Decoded neutral COLOR_0 scalar and offline predicted post-tonemap encoded-sRGB8 luma; no GPU capture is authorized.

barycentric_triangle_test.samples: For every sidewall triangle, evaluate all barycentric triples (i/N,j/N,k/N), i+j+k=N, N>=32.
barycentric_triangle_test.cross_shared_edge_test: For every two-sided indexed edge, evaluate 33 equally spaced points from both incident triangles; scalar mismatch must be <=1e-6.
barycentric_triangle_test.geometric_seam_test: Coincident duplicated vertices and paired seam samples must differ by <=1e-6.
barycentric_triangle_test.hard_failure: Any NaN, extrapolation, shared-edge mismatch, seam mismatch or non-neutral RGB is OFFLINE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL_GPU_NOT_AUTHORIZED.

monotonic_derivative_test.sample_scope: Every projected connected sidewall column and every upper-to-lower barycentric trace in all six pockets and all three LODs.
monotonic_derivative_test.required: All scalar finite differences ds must be <=1e-6; at least 80% of interior unquantized samples must have ds<-1e-5. Predicted luma derivative must retain the same non-positive sign after excluding mask boundaries and one-pixel endpoint neighborhoods.

fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.canonical_projection: Use the frozen v10f pocket-closeup camera, viewport 1920x1080, medium quality, 4x MSAA, object-ID ownership and one-pixel erosion semantics.
fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.per_column_scalar_step_limit: For height H and endpoint difference E, max absolute adjacent in-mask fragment-center scalar step <=min(0.075,1.35*E/(H-1)).
fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.per_column_predicted_luma_step_limit: max absolute adjacent predicted encoded-luma step <=max(4.0,1.5*median absolute nonzero adjacent predicted-luma step).
fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.coverage_requirement: At least 95% of the 11 canonical central columns pass all scalar-step, luma-step, distinct-sample and derivative checks; every failing column and sample coordinate is reported.
fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.hard_band_proxy: No interior adjacent pair may exceed either step limit, and no two neighboring triangles may introduce a shared-edge scalar or predicted-luma jump.
fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.posterization_proxy: After excluding the endpoint neighborhoods, no run longer than 25% of connected height may repeat the same unquantized scalar within 1e-6 unless the full analytic barycentric trace proves a nonzero derivative below pixel sampling resolution.
fragment_step_and_posterization_proxy.claim_boundary: Passing these proxies establishes offline mathematical continuity only; it is not a TA visual PASS and does not replace future actual-GPU inspection.

byte_level_checks: All POSITION, NORMAL, TANGENT, TEXCOORD_0 and index accessors for rim, sidewall and void equal the v10f decoded values and counts.
Sidewall vertex and index counts, two-ring Y values and cross-layer unique-edge counts equal this v2 topology record.
Node transforms, local_ranges, role strings, LOD membership and marker references equal v10f.
Only sidewall material index and sidewall COLOR_0 accessor bytes may differ within this contract.

post_tonemap: Rim remains brightest and inside 40..52 encoded luma.
Sidewall upper remains at least 10 luma below rim; do not flatten rim and upper together.
Sidewall lower remains at least 5 luma above void; do not crush lower into void.
Void median remains 1..3 and void p95 <=4.
Sidewall upper and lower maximum post-tonemap sRGB channel spread remains <=12 and does not shift cyan, gold or walnut-colored.
At least 95% of canonical central columns preserve strict rim > upper > lower > void ordering.
gradient_quality: No one-pixel bright ring, hard horizontal band, posterized step, emissive edge, isolated COLOR_0 discontinuity or derivative sign reversal.
Upper and lower samples remain connected within one sidewall object-ID ownership region.
All v2 barycentric continuity, derivative, fragment-step and posterization proxies pass.
scene_integrity: Full-frame UI delta remains zero and gold component pixels in the bottom band remain zero.
Cushion, facing, felt, walnut, balls, cue, room, exposure and white balance hashes remain frozen.
Texture residency, draw calls, triangles and p95 frame time may not regress beyond existing v10f hard gates.
No new texture, light, render pass, shader branch or production runtime toggle is permitted.

required_outputs: new v10g asset root and hashes without modifying v10f
decoded accessor diff proving only sidewall material index and COLOR_0 changed
topology audit reproducing v2 two-ring and cross-layer edge counts
deterministic candidate grid and rejection report
predicted rim, sidewall upper, sidewall lower and void post-tonemap medians
D_cpu, both calibrated branches, uncertainty reserve and D_gpu_lower
barycentric lattice, shared-edge, seam, derivative, fragment-step and posterization proxy reports
all inherited geometry, ownership, visibility, walnut, drop and connection checks
offline_machine_gate.failure_rule: Any failed, missing, PENDING, unbound, out-of-range, discontinuous or geometry-drifted check is OFFLINE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL_GPU_NOT_AUTHORIZED.

authorization_after_gate.allowed_next_action: Implement and validate the v2 contract offline only.
authorization_after_gate.required_followup: Root must inspect a passing offline package and issue separate authorization before any GPU capture or TA review.
